dedupe_keys.name: revub hydro solar wind balancing model

description: REVUB is a Python model developed by Vrije Universiteit Brussel hydrology researchers for combining hydropower with variable wind and solar output. It simulates reservoir operation under technical, hydrological and environmental constraints and searches for mixes that improve load following. Users prepare plant, inflow, solar, wind and demand series in documented Excel control and data files. Outputs include plant dispatch, reservoir operating rules, capacity credit and hourly to multiannual generation comparisons for a selected region or grid. Geographic coverage is user-defined, and a training case is supplied in English and Spanish. MIT source and a detailed manual are public. A limitation is that dispatch results depend on inflow and demand scenarios; they cannot certify operational feasibility without plant-specific constraints and permits. REVUB can support water-energy planning and drought-resilience studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate whole-system power optimiser, not this hydropower-focused model. No training dataset or software environment was downloaded.
